reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

source_record.scope: Plural genealogy of the selected reliability/maintainability lineage, based on the received native corpus and the explicitly scoped fresh sources. An edge records the type and strength of documentary relation; it is not a universal causal history.

edge_types.DOCUMENTED_PREDECESSOR: The inspected later author explicitly identifies an earlier work or development.
edge_types.DOCUMENTED_UPTAKE: The inspected later document explicitly cites, quotes or incorporates earlier work.
edge_types.DOCUMENTED_CRITICISM: An inspected source directly challenges a named assumption or approach.
edge_types.SHARED_MATHEMATICAL_STRUCTURE: The author establishes a formal relation; historical borrowing is not thereby established.
edge_types.DOMAIN_TRANSLATION: A source explicitly moves a mechanism into a new bearer or practice; effectiveness remains separate.
edge_types.CONVERGENCE_OR_ANALOGY: Similar problems or mechanisms; direct transmission is unestablished.
edge_types.UNRESOLVED_ATTRIBUTION: Historical assertion retained with the missing or conflicting evidence stated.
edge_types.DOCUMENTED_NAMED_CODIFICATION: A later inspected source names a model family also represented by an earlier document. This does not establish direct citation or a transmission chain from that exact earlier document.

competing_accounts.question: One origin or plural origins?
competing_accounts.selected: Plural strands and identifiable documents; no single founder adjudicated.
competing_accounts.alternative: A single sequence from military electronics to software to SRE.
competing_accounts.why_not_selected: Different bearers, questions and simultaneous mathematics; inspected sources do not establish that causal staircase.

competing_accounts.question: Was criticism and tailoring only a recent correction?
competing_accounts.selected: Historical FMECA already criticized late, duplicative and actionless analysis; current implementations may still fail.
competing_accounts.alternative: Older analysis was inherently ceremonial and only modern practice supplied feedback.
competing_accounts.why_not_selected: F046 foreword and section 4.4.2 directly oppose that historical caricature.

competing_accounts.question: Does shared reliability vocabulary prove descent?
competing_accounts.selected: Only source-documented links are causal/documentary edges; formal similarity and analogy are separately typed.
competing_accounts.alternative: Common terms such as recovery, availability or SRE establish intellectual transmission.
competing_accounts.why_not_selected: They can denote different objects; no cited source proves every claimed connection.

competing_accounts.question: Do negative dependence results defeat redundancy?
competing_accounts.selected: They defeat an independence assertion in the studied setting; conditional rescue remains possible.
competing_accounts.alternative: Dependence proves redundancy or design diversity is universally ineffective.
competing_accounts.why_not_selected: The general joint-event identity and C02 give a counterexample; F010 is one application experiment.

remaining_work_not_fabricated: Original 1949 FMECA publication and priority remain unresolved; owner metadata anomaly is preserved.
